A.name: Gera
A.line: father of Shimei (2SA 16:5), son of Bela (1CH 8:5)
family: father-of shimei-2 (Shimei, of the house of Saul (2SA 16:5) who threw stones at King Dav)

B.name: Gera
B.line: A second Gera named among Bela's sons in the same Chronicles list, name repeated or distinct brother.

why: Gera in 8:5 occupies the second Gera position in Bela’s list, after Abishua, Naaman, and Ahoah, matching B’s description. The passage does not identify this Gera as Shimei’s father or establish whether the repeated name represents distinct brothers.
